method.market_probability: each external source's match-winner prices are converted to implied probability and normalised to remove the bookmaker overround; EGamersWorld uses the median price across the bookmakers printed on the page, Pinnacle uses its public guest moneyline; the sources' de-vigged probabilities are then averaged
method.own_line: standard Elo expectation 1/(1+10^(-dP/400)) on published rating points (HLTV world ranking and Valve Regional Standings, averaged where both cover both teams)
method.combined_estimate: 70% market + 30% own line when both exist; whichever single source exists otherwise, flagged
method.policy: Hotspawn crowd pick percentages are read by the collector for transparency, dropped before publication, and never influence a probability or a pick (enforced by the build gate)
